app.title: Install the Hikvision SDK Bridge app
app.description:
The doorbell chime needs the Hikvision SDK Bridge app, and this integration does not work without it. Install it, then press Submit to check again.

1. [Add the app repository]({add_repository_link}) (or add `{repository_url}` under Settings → Apps → App store → Repositories).
2. Install **Hikvision SDK Bridge**. It can stay stopped; this integration starts it.
3. Come back here and press Submit.

account.title: Hikvision Intercom
account.description: Log in with your Hik-Connect account. Live video streams directly from the station over your LAN; discovery and the controls (unlock, calls, volumes) go through the Hik-Connect cloud. The next step connects the local station for the doorbell chime.

data.base_url: Custom API URL (only when Server is Custom)

data_description.server: Pick your region, or Custom to enter an API URL. Global auto-routes to the right region.
data_description.base_url: e.g. apiieu.hik-connect.com — used only when Server is set to Custom.

station.title: Indoor station connection
station.description: Use the station's admin password, not your Hik-Connect password. Only the SDK Bridge app stores it; this integration does not.

confirm.title: Confirm app configuration
confirm.description: The Hikvision SDK Bridge app's station list will be updated and the app started or restarted if needed; other stations in the app may briefly disconnect. No unlock, alarm, firmware or playback action is performed.

data.confirm_restart: I confirm the app configuration and a restart if needed

data_description.call_poll_interval: Seconds between cloud call-status polls. Realtime push already reports rings immediately; a shorter interval only helps when push is unavailable, at the cost of more cloud requests.
data_description.native_stream: Native streams pass the station's own video to Home Assistant (WebRTC/HLS, HomeKit Bridge with `video_codec: copy`) instead of transcoding to MJPEG: lower CPU use and faster start. Most browsers and HomeKit can't play H.265, so H.265 channels use MJPEG unless you include them.

reconfigure.title: Chime sound
reconfigure.description: The file is optional. WAV: 8000 Hz, mono, 16-bit PCM, at most 1 MiB and 30 seconds. Repetitions combined may not exceed 60 seconds. Positive gain may distort and cannot raise the station's hardware volume. Saving never plays sound.
